postprocessing.selection_basis: All geometry limits are held constant from v20. The v20 errors are addressed through preregistered data replay rather than post-audit geometry editing.

sampling.selection_basis: Preregistered in configs/supervised_labeler_v21_gt_review.yaml before any v21 pool pixels or training were opened. Exact v20 miss images receive positive replay weight 32 and all v20 false-positive images receive hard-negative replay weight 36.
